title: Surreal Bayou Twilight
description: A surreal scene set on a wooden dock over a bayou at sunset. A bearded man sits in a red Radio Flyer wagon building a miniature house while a glowing purple vortex swirls around him; nearby a blonde woman in a black dress sits in a purple hammock, another blonde woman emerges from a swirling vortex in the sky, and a purple mouse floats inside a smaller glowing ring.
prompt: Surreal twilight bayou scene with Spanish moss on ancient trees. A man with dark curly hair and beard sits in a red Radio Flyer wagon on a wooden dock, building a tiny wooden house as a glowing purple spiral vortex swirls around him. A blonde woman in a black dress relaxes in a purple hammock on the porch. In the sky, a giant swirling vortex reveals another smiling blonde woman with flowing hair, while a purple cartoon mouse floats inside a smaller glowing ring. Pink petals drift through the air, warm sunset light over the water, detailed digital painting style.
